motors.label: Lite: APS 8072S ~25 Kv on wall power
motors.note: The low-cost build: the main build's frame, mount and motor body (400 x 227 x 103 mm), plugged into the wall. A Mean Well 36 V 600 W supply inside, an ODrive S1 with two brake resistors on the base plate, and a phone app (Bluetooth) and a knob instead of the battery, Raspberry Pi and touchscreen. The motor is wound ~25 Kv to order, so 158 lb takes 37-45 A.

motors.label: APS 8072S 50 Kv outrunner
motors.note: The main build: 400 x 227 x 103 mm. Light rotor (about 2.5 kg felt at the rope before compensation); 13 N·m; ODrive Pro.

motors.label: MP80100 50 Kv outrunner
motors.note: Same frame with a 44 mm longer motor bay (444 mm). About 4 kg felt at the rope; ODrive Pro; ships from China.

motors.label: MP80100 rewired wye, ~29 Kv (check first)
motors.note: The 444 mm MP80100 build on the same ODrive Pro. If the 50 Kv motor is wound delta, re-terminating it in wye gives about 29 Kv, so 220 lb takes about 60 A (the ODrive Pro gives 70 A continuous). Ask the seller how it is wound before buying for 220 lb.

motors.label: APS C80100, custom ~25 Kv
motors.note: Alien Power Systems winds it to order at about 25 Kv: 220 lb takes about 52-63 A on the same ODrive Pro. Its own build is 429 mm long (the motor is 15 mm shorter than the MP80100).

parts.name: APS 8072S outrunner, 50 Kv
parts.note: Alien Power Systems, UK: about £169 plus shipping. The main build's motor.

parts.name: MP80100 outrunner, 50 Kv, sensored
parts.note: Freerchobby, via AliExpress: $230 + $30 shipping, ships from China (3-4 weeks). Cut its bell-end prop shaft to a 10 mm stub.

parts.name: APS C80100 outrunner, sensored, custom ~25 Kv
parts.note: Alien Power Systems, UK: stock 50 Kv is £209 plus shipping (on backorder October 10); ask APS for the ~25 Kv winding and its price before ordering. Ø80 x 92, 4 x M5 on Ø56, 12 mm keyed shaft; cut its rear shaft to a 10 mm stub.

parts.name: APS 8072S outrunner, custom ~25 Kv
parts.note: Alien Power Systems winds it to order: ask for about 25 Kv (the stock motor is 50 Kv). Same body, mount and 10 mm keyed shaft as the main build. Not quoted yet.

parts.name: ODrive Pro ODv44-ST
parts.note: Controller only; heat spreader is separate. 70 A continuous: the 220 lb choices use a lower-Kv motor to stay inside it.

parts.name: ODrive S1, solder-pad version
parts.note: 40 A continuous on its heat spreader, 80 A peak, 12-50.5 V, with an onboard magnetic encoder. Screws to a 6061 plate you make; the main build's ODrive bracket stays. In stock at ODrive (US) on Oct 10.

parts.name: ODrive Pro heat spreader
parts.note: Thermal hardware allowance.

parts.name: Thunder Power TP2700-5SR70
parts.note: 5S 2.7 Ah LiPo, EC5 leads. Two packs in series, on the printed TP2700 spacer. For more charge, the bay also takes 2 x TP3300-5SR70 (3.3 Ah, 122 Wh a pair against 100 Wh, regen to 39.6 A; $134.99 each, no spacer).

parts.name: Mean Well LOP-600-36 power supply
parts.note: 36 V open frame: 400 W by convection, 600 W with airflow, 150 % for 3 s. Jameco: $83.60 plus a 26 % tariff added at checkout; 3-week lead time, non-returnable.

parts.name: JBD 10-17S 80 A smart BMS (same port, Bluetooth)
parts.note: US-stocked (a California eBay seller, 2-4 day delivery). Same port, so regen charges through it; NTC probe. The CAD is sized for its 102 x 65 x 12 mm board. Set over-charge to 4.20-4.25 V per cell in its app.

parts.name: uxcell 50 W 1 Ω aluminium resistors, 5-pack

parts.name: MINI 58 V 3 A fuse (Littelfuse 0997003.WXN)

parts.name: Inline MINI fuse holder, 58 V DC (Littelfuse 0FHM0003ZXJS)

outsourced.name: Laser-cut plate set, 6061-T6

The prototype's plates came to about $200-300 at SendCutSend (October 2026). Tapping and countersinking are extra, charged per hole.
